{{Short description|Area of math}}
In [[mathematical analysis]], '''idempotent analysis''' is the study of [[idempotent semiring]]s, such as the [[tropical semiring]]. The lack of an additive inverse in the semiring is compensated somewhat by the idempotent rule <math>A \oplus A = A</math>.
